text:
Asha (CS): Heads-up: a subset of Dedicated EU tenants saw delayed indexing for embeddings this morning. Customers noticing stale search and slower retrieval. Opening thread to coordinate customer comms and remediation.

Ben (SRE): Investigating. Early signal: embed-writer pod restarted repeatedly after a bad config rollover; concurrency dropped and backfill stalled.

Ruth (Eng): Root cause: during a config refresh we shipped a config that set `max_inflight=2` instead of 20 for the rewriter. Canary passed (no high load) so the regression went unnoticed.

Jules (Support): Affected tickets: C-9012, C-9020, C-9033. Customers asking if vectors were lost and what compensation is available.

Ben (SRE): No data loss. Re-queued jobs processed after rollback at 07:12 UTC. Backfill completed by 07:40 UTC for known tenants. Adding alert: embed-backlog > 50 triggers page.

Asha (CS): Comms plan: 1) short status to all open tickets now, 2) detailed RCA for renewal-risk accounts, 3) offer 1-week trial extension or a 2-hour ops walkthrough for high-touch.

Ruth (Eng): Draft short status: "We experienced delayed embedding updates for a small group of EU dedicated tenants from 06:5807:12 UTC due to a configuration regression. We reverted the change and ran a prioritized backfill; embeddings are current and no data was lost. Reply if you still see issues."

Jules (Support): I'll send that to the open tickets. For credits: agree with 1-week extension or 10% one-time credit for affected customers.

Ben (SRE): Preventive steps: CI config lint to catch small numeric regressions, add a deploy-time smoke that verifies embed freshness within 5 minutes, and lock the rewriter config behind a feature flag.

Asha (CS): I'll prepare two templates: short status + exec RCA. Also schedule two office hours for follow-up. Need verification of each tenant's backfill status before sending exec notes.

Ben (SRE): Confirmed backfill job IDs attached to tickets. All known queues drained by 07:40 UTC.

Asha (CS): Great. Plan to send initial status at 09:00 UTC and follow-up personalized RCA + comp offers by 13:00 UTC. Please flag urgent edits before 08:50 UTC.

AlertBot: Deploy rollback completed at 07:14 UTC. System health green.

Jules (Support): Short status posted to all affected tickets. Copy: "Issue identified and resolved; backfill complete; no data lost; let us know if anything remains out of date."

Asha (CS): Thanks team. I'll post final sent copies here after send and log feedback from office hours.
